title: One shell and one type system
decision: Rebuild the sidebar, header, and profile footer on one type scale, or only swap tokens.

options.label: One shell and one type system

wickman.reason: One system or the pages diverge again

graham.reason: Chrome that does not help is playing house

musk.reason: Delete the breadcrumb and the third type system

buffett.reason: The word score in profile copy is a leak

brief: Three type systems, three widths, a repeating breadcrumb, and a profile form that is not saved. The founder wants one calm scale and a shell that looks finished. Practice drills stay as they are.
assumptions: Apple-inspired means quiet type and one accent
